questions.stem: The obstetrician explains a planned cesarean hysterectomy. Afterward, the client says, "I didn't understand. Will I still be able to have more children?" Which actions should the nurse take? Select all that apply.

Hold the consent form until questions are answered

Tell the client the doctor knows best
